models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Light and flat across the Aeolians - under 7 kt everywhere in the current runs, but the trip dates are still long-lead.
briefing.synopsis: The pattern over the islands is slack: no organised gradient, winds under about 5 kt swinging between a nocturnal S/SE land breeze and a N to NE afternoon flow, per the consensus sampled in the payload (ECMWF IFS 0.25° and MFWAM/ECMWF WAM 00Z 02 Oct, ECMWF AIFS 06Z 02 Oct, ICON-2i 00Z 02 Oct). Seas are essentially nil - wave and swell 0.1-0.5 ft at every island through 04 Oct. Model guidance runs to 08 Oct 23:00, so figures exist for every leg, but anything past about 05 Oct is pattern-level only and should not be planned around. If this slack regime holds it means motoring more than sailing, with gusts quoted as interval maxima (e.g. 13-15 kt against a 4-5 kt mean) that read large only because the mean is so light.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Tomorrow night (03 Oct) the fleet is at Portorosa and the recommended berth is Portorosa Marina - enclosed, all-round shelter, and the only option scored. Forecast there is SE 4.6 kt, gusts 8.9 kt, swell 0.1 ft (ECMWF IFS 0.25°, 00Z 02 Oct run, with AIFS 06Z agreeing on the light regime). Nothing in the payload would push the fleet to move.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Departure day proper is 04 Oct for Portorosa to Lipari; the payload's recommended slot is a 06:00 start, SSE 4.8 kt gusting 10.9 kt, wave 0.1 ft, dead downwind at 175 TWA - i.e. an engine leg. Wind backs to ENE then NNE through the middle of the day and the breeze stays Beaufort 1-2 all afternoon, so there is no deteriorating trend in the data to beat.
